description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time status, timezone information, and event handling via JSON-RPC in a plugin environment. It includes methods for subscribing to time events, updating time status and timezone, parsing timezone transitions, and event loop processing.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: Manages system time status, timezone info, event subscriptions, and event loop processing within the plugin framework.

methods.name: SystemTime::SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing event thread and event queue.

methods.name: SystemTime::~SystemTime
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up event thread and unsubscribing from events.

methods.name: SystemTime::IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether system time is available based on current status.

methods.name: SystemTime::GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves timezone offset in seconds and accuracy.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles time status change events, enqueues event for processing.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Handles timezone DST change events, enqueues event for processing.

methods.name: SystemTime::CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes JSON-RPC link with system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SystemTime::SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to time status and timezone change events via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries system for current time quality/status and updates internal state.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Queries system for current timezone and accuracy, updates internal state.

methods.name: SystemTime::ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timezone string and transition map to determine current offset and accuracy.

methods.name: SystemTime::PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates timezone transition map by parsing 'zdump' command output.

methods.name: SystemTime::EventLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing initialization, time status, timezone, and shutdown events.
